lines.en: if gpmexd == True:
scene gpmexd1 with dissolve
: Hmm...
scene gpmexd2 with dissolve
: What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: else:
scene gpmexd1 with dissolve2
$ renpy.pause(2, hard=True)
scene gpmexd2 with dissolve2
: Hmmmmm...
lines.zh: : Hmmmmm...

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Amy?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗，Amy？

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’d say anything is {i}wrong.{/i} But the sky seems kind of off in here, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我不知道能不能说有哪里{i}不对劲{/i}。但这里的天空好像有点怪，对吧？

lines.en: : I guess it does when you put it that way. Maybe it’s because it’s missing clouds?
lines.zh: : 你这么说的话确实有点。也许是因为没有云？

lines.en: : Ahh! That’s definitely it. I haven’t seen the sky in so long that I kind of forget how it’s supposed to look sometimes.
lines.zh: : 啊！绝对是这个。我太久没看过天空了，有时候都忘了它该长什么样。

lines.en: : It’s easy to notice if I’m reading a picture book or something. But I feel like any time there’s just a bunch of faded blue within my line of sight, I find myself sort of zoning out.
lines.zh: : 如果我在看图画书之类的，就很容易注意到。但我觉得只要视野里出现一大片褪色的蓝，我就会有点走神。

lines.en: : Is that some sort of medical condition?
lines.zh: : 那是某种病症吗？

lines.en: : Maybe! It’s been that way since I was a baby, though. So chances are I was probably born with it if that’s the case.
lines.zh: : 也许吧！不过我从婴儿时期就这样了。所以如果是的话，我很可能是天生的。

lines.en: : Do you have any birth defects, Akira? The fun kind. Not the sad kind like SIDS.
lines.zh: : 你有什么先天缺陷吗，Akira？好玩的那种。不是像婴儿猝死症那种悲伤的。

lines.en: : Just the ever-present sadness that thrives and blooms inside of me.
lines.zh: : 只有那份永远存在、在我体内滋长绽放的悲伤。

lines.en: : Is SIDS even a birth defect? It’s not, is it? Let me go ask an employee!
lines.zh: : 婴儿猝死症算先天缺陷吗？不算吧？我去问问员工！

lines.en: scene gpmexd3
: Excuse me!
lines.zh: : 打扰一下！

lines.en: : Amy, we shouldn’t disturb the employees here. They’re probably busy with the grand opening of-
lines.zh: : Amy，我们不该打扰这里的员工。他们大概正忙着开业典礼——

lines.en: scene gpmexd4
: Hi! My name’s Harmony. Welcome to the Blissful Biosphere! How can I help you?
lines.zh: : 你好！我叫 Harmony。欢迎来到极乐生物圈！有什么能帮你的吗？

lines.en: : Is SIDS a birth defect?
lines.zh: : 婴儿猝死症算先天缺陷吗？

lines.en: : SIDS? No, that’s a syndrome. It’s not really a thing people can be born with.
lines.zh: : 婴儿猝死症？不算，那是一种综合征。并不是人一出生就会带的东西。

lines.en: : Okay! Thank you, Harmony. You can leave now.
lines.zh: : 好！谢谢你，Harmony。你可以走了。

lines.en: : I’m glad to have been of service!
lines.zh: : 很高兴能帮上忙！

lines.en: scene gpmexd5
: Great news, Dad! It looks like we don’t have to worry about either of us dying from SIDS!
lines.zh: : 好消息，爸！看来我们俩都不用担心会死于婴儿猝死症了！

lines.en: : What did you just call me?
lines.zh: : 你刚叫我什么？

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : Amy...
lines.zh: : Amy……

lines.en: : It was a slip of the tongue, okay?! Like when you accidentally call your teacher “Mom!”
lines.zh: : 那只是口误，行吗？！就像你不小心把老师叫成「妈！」那样！

lines.en: : Which I did a bunch of times when I was younger since my mom {i}was{/i} my teacher. But it was still embarrassing either way! And I won’t let you make me feel bad about it!
lines.zh: : 我小时候就干过好多次，因为我妈{i}就是{/i}我老师。但不管怎么说那还是很尴尬！而且我不会让你拿这事让我难受的！

lines.en: : You should know by now that I don’t want to make you feel bad about anything.
lines.zh: : 你现在该知道了，我不想让你因为任何事难受。

lines.en: : Amy?
lines.zh: : Amy？

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. I was zoning out from looking at all of the blue again.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我又盯着那片蓝看走神了。

lines.en: : Do you want a drink? I heard a rumor about them storing water inside the planks on all of the benches. We just need to crack one open first!
lines.zh: : 你想喝点东西吗？我听到个传言，说他们把水储存在所有长椅的木板里。我们只要先撬开一块就行！

lines.en: : There you go about “rumors” again. Seriously, what’s going on here?
lines.zh: : 你又说「传言」了。说真的，这儿到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : I didn’t mean it like that! That was more of a rumor about wood in general. I don’t know anything about how dangerous this place is. Seriously.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思！那更算是关于木头的一般性传言。我一点都不知道这地方有多危险。说真的。

lines.en: : Just like you seriously didn’t push your ex-boyfriend into a hole in the wall.
lines.zh: : 就像你「说真的」没把你前男友推进墙上的洞里一样。

lines.en: : Exactly! Now, you’re starting to get it.
lines.zh: : 没错！你开始懂了。

lines.en: : Come on! Let’s go remove some bench panels together!
lines.zh: : 来嘛！我们一起去拆几块长椅的板子！

lines.en: scene gpmexd6
Amy runs off and begins to try and pull one of the panels off of a wooden bench.
lines.zh: Amy 跑开了，开始试着把一块木板从长木椅上扯下来。

lines.en: scene gpmexd7
: Hey! Leave those alone! That water is for VIPs only!
lines.zh: : 嘿！别动那些！那些水只给 VIP 用！

lines.en: : Ah! Akira, run! They’re onto us!
lines.zh: : 啊！Akira，快跑！他们发现我们了！

lines.en: scene gpmexd8
: No! Get back here, you vandal! You need to spend at least nineteen days in a septic tank to pay for this!
lines.zh: : 不行！给我回来，你这个破坏公物的！你得在化粪池里待至少十九天来抵这笔账！

lines.en: : Make an exception for me! I’m on a date!
lines.zh: : 给我破个例吧！我在约会！

lines.en: scene gpmexd9
: You! Regular guy! Are you on a date with that girl?
lines.zh: : 你！那个普通男的！你在跟那个女孩约会吗？

lines.en: : Nope. In fact, I’ve never even seen her before.
lines.zh: : 没有。事实上，我之前根本没见过她。

lines.en: : Hmm...I guess she’s talking about an imaginary friend then. Maybe it’s the fumes.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我想她说的是想象出来的朋友了。也许是这些气味闹的。

lines.en: : Okay! Carry on!
lines.zh: : 好！你们继续吧！

lines.en: scene gpmexd1
Suddenly, I am all alone again.
lines.zh: 忽然间，我又只剩一个人了。

$ renpy.block_rollback()
go straight

go right

go left

$ renpy.block_rollback()
